attachment.description: An image attachment with alt text.

alt.description: Alt text for the image. Required for accessibility.

attachments.description: Images attached to the note. Max 4 attachments, 5MB each

content.description:
The primary note content. Max 3000 graphemes, 30000 bytes
Note: large string limit is intentional for diary-style entries.

contentWarning.description: Content warning label. When present, note content should be hidden by default. Max 100 graphemes, 1000 bytes

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this note was originally created.

langs.description: Indicates human language of note primary text content.

tags.description: Array of string used to tags or categorize the note. Avoid prepending with hashtags.

items.description: Tag to categorize the note. Max 128 graphemes, 1280 bytes
